Their buyers' own home is not under contract and goes live Monday — that weak spot is what makes this workable, and the conversation is now 12 days old

That is a status, not the DATE this file needs, and it is the first date anyone has attached to the permit at all. Get the actual closeout date, then call the buyer's agent back with it. The buyers are still described as 'very concerned' and nothing has gone to them in writing. The written 'interested: Yes' backup buyer has now gone five days uncalled

Seth's question about what the buyer credit and concession actually cover has been open eleven days and the corrected net sheet still has not gone out. Two moves before 1:15: get him the numbers, and tell the buyer's agent the house is being walked again today. New traffic during an open offer is leverage only if the offer side hears about it
